statement: To protect the CMS integration, new deal creation will be simplified to core (makeup) fields with gates and controls.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: we need to put a lot of gates and controls around this entire deal creation and management process to make sure that it doesn't break there. What that means is um the new deal creation is going to be far more simplified just core fields.

topic: Makeup editable before activation
statement: Until activation the deal is like a draft; editing the makeup updates the IDs and external IDs.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Uh, but essentially until a deal is activated, I've opened up the ability to edit the makeup uh without it uh like and editing the makeup will update the uh IDs and external IDs on all of that

statement: Joyce said reactivating a closed deal could require updated data (commercial terms may differ). statement: After activation the makeup fields are locked and non-sync fields stay editable; what can and cannot be deleted is still TBD.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: If you go to edit the deal, all of the makeup fields are locked. Um, anything that's not material to the sync can still be edited. Um, and this is still TBD, so we can finalize uh, what can and cannot be deleted.

topic: Status changes gated by action buttons
statement: Direct status editing is removed; deal status transitions go through specific action buttons.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Uh, and notice we we remove the ability to edit the status directly. Um, so we're going to gate it through specific action buttons.

quote: Emily Vandenberg: We'll we'll probably end up building logic around like, you know, automate the pause once you've hit caps down the road and stuff.

statement: Historical links and DRAs on a closed deal are not removed (to keep reporting); they can be put in an inactive/gated status. Emily agreed.

topic: Retire as terminal status with replacement
statement: Retire is a terminal status: everything locks, the makeup is released, and a replacement deal can be created with a retired/replaces lookup.

topic: Cloning replacement deal may be V2
statement: Kobi said the cloning/replacement deal experience might be a V2 enhancement.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: this whole like cloning and replacement deal. I think we this might be like a V2 enhancement

topic: Archive status need if versioning
statement: If versions are introduced, archive may only be needed as a terminal status, distinct from closed (an extended pause that can be reactivated).

statement: A deal with no signups for 90 days (configurable setting) moves to an informational inactive status and returns to active when a signup comes in.

topic: Commercial terms stamped on signup
statement: Commercial terms (payout model, deposit range, currency, rev share/hybrid) must be stamped on the signup as of the first bet; Kobi believes this is for operational reporting only.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Um and from our conversation, we said that this information um one it needs to get stamped on the signup. So when you report on a sign up, you can see what the commercial terms was at the time the sign up first bet was completed.

quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So the effective end date for the previous commercial term is the is one day prior to the effective start date of the new term.

statement: Signups link to the commercial term whose effective dates contain the signup's first bet date.
quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: We're actually, uh, linking the commercial term that's effective for that signup based on when when the first bet date lands, uh, between these two dates.
